text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: automated alert - KV prefix cache hit-rate collapse for tenant crescent-bank (vpc-nyc-1 / dedicated-pool-7). Severity=P1. Root thread ts=2034006789

alice.s: I'm on it. Seeing increased p50 latency for crescent requests and token cost spikes. Dashboards show prefix hitrate dropping from ~92% to 6% at 08:07 UTC.

carla.sre: Confirmed. KV miss rate spiking across replicas in pool 7. Redis/kv-exporter shows heavy prefix churn. Possible cache pollution from large prefix list.

ben.platform: Any config changes rolled out in the last hour? No deploys in pool-7 in the window per deploy-bot.

eskappa: Checking routing: smart-router reports ~30% of requests redirected to fallback model due to cache misses. That explains cost jump.

liaison-support: Customer (Crescent Bank) reporting elevated error rates in their app. They're seeing slow responses and timeouts. I've opened a support ticket and told them we're investigating.

alice.s: Running quick mitigation options: 1) disable tenant prefetch/pinning for crescent-bank, 2) apply tenant-specific kv-ttl bump to reduce noisy churn, 3) isolate tenant to spare LRU slab. Any objections?

ben.platform: +1 to disable prefetch first. Lower risk, immediate. How fast to flip?

carla.sre: We can flip feature flag via ops-console: feature.kv.prefetch.crescent=false. Will take ~30s to propagate. Doing it now.

carla.sre: (after 45s) flag flipped :white_check_mark: Watching hit-rate.

eskappa: Hit-rate up from 6% -> 18% within 90s. p50 latency improving. Still below baseline but trending good. Keep monitoring.

liaison-support: Told Crescent support we disabled prefetch and are seeing early improvement. They appreciate quick action.

infra-ops: Noted a set of abnormal prefixes from crescent observed in logs: many long synthetic keys coming from a single host pool behind their gateway. Could be malformed client behavior. Logged sample: crescent:user:session:0f4a9c... repeated with many unique suffixes.

alice.s: Could be a bug in their client creating high-cardinality keys. We should ask them for recent client release/version. PM-olivia, can you coordinate?

pm-olivia: On it. Reached out to the Crescent engineering contact asking for a deploy diff and traffic samples.

carla.sre: For safety, I'm going to temporarily increase kv-ttl for crescent tenant prefixes to 300s (from 60s) to reduce churn on backing store. Will run as a targeted override. Executing:

```
# ops-cli
ops kv set-override --tenant crescent-bank --prefix "crescent:" --ttl 300
```
carla.sre: Override applied. Monitoring effects.

eskappa: Nice, hit-rate steady at ~36% now. Cost trending down. Still seeing some cold-starts for certain prefixes.

alice.s: Next step: isolate their cache slab to avoid cross-tenant eviction. Ben, can you provision a temporary tenant slab in pool-7? We have capacity in dedicated-pool-8 if migration needed.

ben.platform: Provisioning tenant-slab-crescent on pool-8 and scheduling a transparent migration. Will route their traffic to slab-crescent in 10m.

infra-ops: Note: migration will briefly double memory usage due to replication. Remove any non-essential background batch jobs on pool-8.

liaison-support: Crescent says they can throttle a noisy service if we need them to. They've paused one background job in staging.

eskappa: After routing to new slab, eviction noise stopped. Hit-rate stabilized ~68% after 6 minutes. Latency is back to normal range.

carla.sre: Running final sanity checks on replica consistency and kv-index. All OK.

alice.s: Great work. I'll start an incident summary and notify on-call rotation for handoff. Carla, can you write the runbook actions so eng-runtime can prevent recurrence?

carla.sre: Adding to runbook: - detect tenant high-cardinality key pattern threshold (N unique prefixes/min) -> auto-disable prefetch + ttl bump + schedule slab isolation. Also add an alert for sudden prefix count delta.

ben.platform: I'll add an automation to provision temporary slabs faster (reduce manual prov time from 10m -> 90s). Ticket created: INFRA-4721.

pm-olivia: Crescent engineer replied: they shipped a change that started appending request IDs to prefix keys incorrectly. They're rolling a rollback and will push a fix in their next patch. They've requested an incident summary for their compliance team.

liaison-support: I'll prepare a short timeline and impact summary for Crescent: start time 08:07 UTC, mitigation: prefetch disabled 08:08, ttl override 08:09, slab isolation + routing 08:20, restored hit-rate & latency by 08:26.

alice.s: Handoff: I'm going off-call at 09:00 UTC. Carla, you're primary for the follow-up and postmortem. Please include action owners and ETA on automation.

carla.sre: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with eng-runtime and infra.

incident-bot: On-call handoff recorded: outgoing=alice.s, incoming=carla.sre, handoff_ts=2034010000.

alice.s: Final note — request a short retro with Crescent to review client-side guardrails (key cardinality limits) and our tenant isolation SLAs. We should also add a tenant-specific prefetch circuit-breaker.

carla.sre: Will include all items. I'll also schedule a playbook test during the next SRE game day.

ben.platform: Pushing changes to infra pipeline to support faster slab provisioning. Will reference INFRA-4721 in postmortem.

liaison-support: Ticket #CRES-1185 updated with timeline and customer communication.

pm-olivia: Thanks everyone. Closing the active paging. Please add any missing notes to the incident doc.

alice.s: :thumbsup: Closing from my side as well.

carla.sre: Postmortem draft will be ready by EOD.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: P1 -> resolved at 2034010389.
